info.name: Core accepted countries auth controls API
Lists all global auth control exceptions for the program

params.name: card_product
params.description: Card product token. Use "null" to get auth controls that are not associated with any card product.

params.name: user
params.description: User token. Use "null" to get auth controls that are not associated with any user.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of items to retrieve. Count can be between 1 - 10 items.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Indicates from what row to start returning data.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-delimited list of fields to return (e.g. field_1,field_2,..). Leave blank to return all fields.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field by which to sort the returned items. Use any field in the model, or system fields lastModifiedTime or createdTime.

items.docs: Lists all global auth control exceptions for the program
